subject: Bootcamp partnership credits and onboarding plan
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@opensprint.org>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood credits for Nov community bootcamp

Hi Jonas + Marissa —

Thanks for connecting last week. OpenSprint is running a free 3-day web-dev bootcamp for early contributors (150 attendees) Nov 9–11 and we'd love to include Redwood as the compute partner for interactive coding labs. Rough ask: a promotional credit allocation for hosted inference plus a short trial extension for a subset of cohort mentors who will integrate the SDK during the event.

Key asks:
- Promotional credits: cover ~150 accounts (est. 20–30k tokens equivalent per attendee for the labs)
- Trial extension: 90 days for mentor accounts to support follow-ups
- Quick onboarding/checklist and a point of contact for SSO/SCIM questions

I've attached the draft schedule and expected instructor roster. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — next week works for us.

Attachments: Bootcamp_Schedule.pdf (program schedule), Bootcamp_Roster.csv (instructors & org leads)

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Community Programs Manager
OpenSprint

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@opensprint.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for Nov community bootcamp

Hi Elaine —

Really appreciate the outreach and congrats on getting such a big cohort together. We can absolutely support community bootcamps like this; want to make sure we set expectations correctly on allocation and onboarding. Quick answers:

- Promo credits: we can provision an initial promotional pool and scoped trial accounts for mentors. Need final attendee counts and whether you want per-user accounts or class-shared keys.
- Trial extension: 90 days is reasonable, though for mentor accounts we usually do a 120-day extended trial for follow-up projects — willing to consider 120 for training + projects.
- Fast onboarding: we'll share a lightweight onboarding checklist and a short runbook for the lab exercises.

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Marissa (program credits) and Soojin (partner ops) to propose an allocation and brief SLA for the event. Can you confirm a final headcount by Nov 1 and whether you're asking for separate mentor accounts?

If all looks good I can draft a simple MOU and sponsorship form for signature. Would a kickoff call Tuesday (10/27) 10am PT work?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood credits for Nov community bootcamp

Thanks for the details — quick internal note on allocation and approvals.

Proposal:
- Promo pool: 50,000 credits reserved for OpenSprint for the Nov cohort (shared pool; we can split into per-user if they provide emails)
- Mentor trial extension: 120-day trial for up to 12 mentor accounts
- Kickoff & runbook: partner ops will publish a short onboarding checklist; Soojin can own SSO/SCIM questions

Constraints & asks from finance:
- We need a signed Sponsorship Form and HubSpot record (please push to HS-987654) before we provision the promo pool
- Confirm whether the cohort will use shared API keys (easiest) or per-user onboarding (higher support cost)

I've attached the proposed allocation sheet for legal/finance signoff. If you want us to increase the pool after the event we can evaluate usage and impact (standard process).

Attachments: promo_allocation_sheet.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Strategic Programs — Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@opensprint.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-27T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for Nov community bootcamp

Hi Elaine —

All good to proceed with the proposed plan from our side. Next concrete steps for OpenSprint to unblock provisioning:
1) Please sign the attached Sponsorship_Form.pdf (I can send via DocuSign) — this captures the allocation, timeline, and simple usage terms.
2) Confirm final headcount by Nov 1 and whether you prefer shared API keys or per-user accounts for attendees. For mentors we will provision per-user trial accounts (up to 12) with 120-day extensions.
3) Share the HubSpot lead id or confirm we can create HS-987654 and add the contact list.

I'll also schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 10/27 10am PT as suggested — if that conflicts, tell us a preferred time and we'll adjust. Once Sponsorship_Form is signed, Marissa will provision the promo pool (50,000 credits) and Soojin will send the onboarding checklist & runbook.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/pack/Redwood_Bootcamp_MOU
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4bootcamp

Thanks — excited to partner on this!

Jonas Weber
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Sponsorship_Form.pdf
